description.zh: 四季来自地轴倾斜约 23.4° 且方向不变，让太阳直射点一年内在南北回归线之间往返，正午太阳高度和昼长随之变化；日地距离只变化约 3%，不是原因。仅为几何模型，不含大气与热惯性。
description.en: The seasons come from Earth’s axis being tilted about 23.4° in a fixed direction, so the overhead point swings between the tropics over a year and noon Sun height and day length follow; the Earth–Sun distance changes only about 3% and is not the cause. A geometric model without atmosphere or thermal lag.

label.zh: 单位面积受热 ∝ sin h

reason.zh: 太阳高度角为 h 时，一束阳光铺在地面上的面积按 1/sin h 变化，所以单位面积的受热与 sin h 成正比，这是夏热冬冷的几何原因。
reason.en: At Sun altitude h one beam spreads over a ground area of 1/sin h, so heat per unit area is proportional to sin h, the geometric reason summer is warm and winter cold.
